_comment: LoopStar GENERATIVE material pack (LP.6). Genre-authentic DNA for the on-device 'Make it new' generator (LoopStarMaterialEngine). The Swift binary is a SKELETON (RULE #1). Companion phrase pack: phrases/grime/. Source: docs/idiom-research/genre-hiphop.md section 4 (GM numbers there are 0-indexed, taken verbatim). Grime has no glide culture and a dead-straight grid; bass style uses the closest existing enum (rootDriven) until a riffBass enum ships. Schema owner: LoopStarGenrePack.swift.
name: Grime
blurb: Eski grime at 140: an icy square-wave riff that doubles as the bass, cold string-slam stabs, and a broken 2-step kick under sparse straight hats.

flavors.label: Eskibeat
flavors.blurb: Wiley's icy hollow grid: one chord, cold triad slams, nothing warm anywhere.

flavors.label: Sublow
flavors.blurb: Almost no chords at all: one held minor drone under the sub riff.

flavors.label: Devil Slam
flavors.blurb: The b2 devil note slammed against the tonic, dead straight, no swing.

flavors.label: String Slam
flavors.blurb: Ruff Sqwad strings walking the full i-bVI-bIII-bVII loop.

flavors.label: Weightless
flavors.blurb: Grime with the aggression removed: two slow chords, all sustain, no grid.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: Grime is 140 and minor, and the riff IS the harmony: often one chord for the whole bar while a square-wave lead and the sub carry everything. Bare triads only, because 7ths and 9ths sound like trap and kill it. Color comes from bVI, bVII and bIII slams and the Phrygian b2 menace. Never cadence.
